notes.subject: dɛmɛ
notes.rationale: ישועה is 'deliverance/victory'; rendered dɛmɛ (help/rescue), the nearest plain Bamanankan word.

notes.subject: ⟨o⟩
notes.rationale: Object pronoun supplied before the verb 'bila' — the Hebrew verb תשוה carries the object in its form.

notes.subject: תשוה
notes.rationale: Root means 'to level/equalize': some read 'you make him equal to (crown him with) splendor'; the placement reading 'bila a kan' is chosen.

translation: A ka ngoro ka bon i ka dɛmɛ kɔnɔ; ja ani ɲɛjɛ, i bɛ ⟨o⟩ bila a kan.
